question: ablation.py records three different results for full@seed7 across three artifacts. Is training irreproducible at a fixed seed, or does `full` name different flag sets? The artifacts cannot say. The GPU can.
answer: IRREPRODUCIBLE. Three runs of the SAME config at the SAME seed with the SAME code produced three DISTINCT results. `--seed` does not pin the outcome.
method: python pipeline/ablation.py --seeds 1 --configs full --out <name>, run 3x back to back on one box, no code change between runs.
root_cause: ablation.py sets torch.manual_seed(seed) and np.random.default_rng(seed) -- the seed IS applied -- but sets NO determinism controls. train_stage2.py:167 sets torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True and :170 torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True). ablation.py has neither, so GPU kernel nondeterminism is uncontrolled.

RETRACTED_inference.what_I_wrote: From n=2 probes (0.6940 vs 0.6926, diff 0.0014) I inferred the historical spread was ~19x in-session nondeterminism and therefore that code or data drift contributed on top of it.
RETRACTED_inference.why_it_was_wrong: n=2 gives one difference and it happened to be a small draw. At n=3 the in-session sd is 0.0062 against a historical sd of 0.0146 -- 2.4x, not 19x.
RETRACTED_inference.verdict: CANNOT distinguish the historical spread from nondeterminism alone at n=3 (p=0.3025). The cross-file disagreement is fully explained by irreproducibility; invoking code drift is unsupported.

implication_for_the_shared_seeds: Seeds 8 and 9 are BIT-IDENTICAL for `full` across three artifacts. With nondeterminism this large, three independent runs agreeing to four decimals is not plausible, so those entries were carried over rather than re-run. The `full` columns in the two 10-seed files are therefore NOT independent evidence and must not be pooled as if they were.
what_this_does_NOT_invalidate: The ablation conclusions. Re-analysed unpaired (Welch) because seed is not a valid blocking factor here: full vs no_grl +0.0447 p<0.0001 SIG both ways; full vs no_coral +0.0008 p=0.9124 ns both ways; full vs no_vicreg -0.0115 p=0.1039 ns both ways. Same verdicts as the paired analysis.
n_is_3: Three in-session runs. Enough to prove irreproducibility (3 distinct values is sufficient) but a coarse estimate of its MAGNITUDE. The sd 0.0062 should not be quoted as a precise noise floor.

ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.what_was_tried: Added torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True, cudnn.benchmark=False and torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True) to ablation.py::train_config, mirroring train_stage2.py:166-171.
ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.hypothesis: ablation.py differs from the reproducible trainer only by these lines.
ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.verdict: FALSIFIED. Two consecutive runs with the controls in place gave 0.6827 and 0.6993 — still different, and a wider gap than without them. The fix is NOT claimed; the lines are kept only because they are correct practice and match the sibling trainer.

also_ruled_out.warn_only_letting_a_flagged_op_through: No determinism warning is emitted at all.
also_ruled_out.CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG: Unset for train_stage2.py as well, so it does not distinguish the reproducible trainer from this one.

ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.where_the_nondeterminism_IS: Inside training, not a downstream probe. The ablation EMBEDDING moves (G3_sil 0.6776 vs 0.6758, G4_hit 0.960 vs 0.963), whereas train_stage2.py's embedding is bit-identical across reruns and only its G2 probe moves. Root cause UNKNOWN and not chased further — out of this lane's scope.

stage2_IS_reproducible.test: train_stage2.py --seed 7 with the control flags, rerun, compared field by field against the original ctrl7 report.
stage2_IS_reproducible.reading: All three are the same quantity — the two deltas are sport_acc minus a constant — so exactly ONE thing varies, by 0.0002, and it is the G2 probe rather than the model. The embedding is bit-reproducible.
stage2_IS_reproducible.why_this_matters_for_the_G2_result: The measured effects are 0.0851 (total) and 0.0289 (coral) against 0.0002 of rerun noise — 425x and 145x. The 5-seed stage-2 experiment does NOT inherit the ablation's irreproducibility.

field_meanings._why_this_block_exists: This artifact was written by an ad-hoc script during an investigation, so no committed file documents its schema and check_field_semantics.py correctly reported its field names as explained nowhere. Documenting them here is the only place that can carry it. Nothing measured was changed.
field_meanings.in_session_full_at_seed7.G2_sport_acc: sport-probe accuracy for config `full` at seed 7, one value per consecutive run of `ablation.py --seeds 1 --configs full` on one box with no code change between runs. Three distinct values is the evidence that the seed does not pin the result.
field_meanings.in_session_full_at_seed7.sd: sample sd (ddof=1) of those three runs. n=3 — enough to PROVE irreproducibility (three distinct values suffices) but a coarse estimate of its MAGNITUDE. Do not quote 0.0062 as a noise floor.
field_meanings.in_session_full_at_seed7.all_distinct: true when no two runs produced the same value. This, not the sd, is the load-bearing observation.
field_meanings.historical_full_at_seed7.<filename>: the G2_sport_acc recorded for full@seed7 in each of the three shipped ablation artifacts. They disagree; that disagreement is what prompted the investigation.
field_meanings.RETRACTED_inference.test.F / p_two_sided: F-test comparing the historical spread against the in-session spread, df (2,2). p=0.3025 means the two CANNOT be distinguished, which is why the earlier claim that code drift contributed on top of nondeterminism was withdrawn.
field_meanings.ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.result_full_a: two consecutive runs AFTER adding cudnn.deterministic, cudnn.benchmark=False and use_deterministic_algorithms(warn_only=True) to train_config.
field_meanings.ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.spread_with_f: max minus min of those two runs. LARGER than spread_without_fix_n3, which is why the fix is recorded as falsified rather than shipped as a fix.
field_meanings.ATTEMPTED_FIX_DID_NOT_WORK.spread_withou: max minus min of the three pre-fix runs (0.0113). Compared against spread_with_fix. n=2 vs n=3, so this is a direction, not a measured ratio.
field_meanings.stage2_IS_reproducible.numeric_fields_co: numeric_fields_compared is the count of numeric fields in unified_report.json compared between the original ctrl seed-7 run and a rerun with identical flags. 37.
field_meanings.stage2_IS_reproducible.bit_identical: bit_identical is how many of those 37 came back EXACTLY equal. 34. The 3 that moved are all the same quantity (sport_acc and its two deltas), by 0.0002, and are the G2 probe rather than the model — so the embedding itself is bit-reproducible.
field_meanings.stage2_IS_reproducible.differ: 37 minus bit_identical. Not an independent number; stated because a reader should not have to subtract.
field_meanings._naming_note: These entries name each field in the PROSE, not only in the key. An earlier version put the name only in the key and check_field_semantics.py still reported numeric_fields_compared and fields_that_differ as undocumented — correctly, because it scans string VALUES. A name that appears only as a key is a label, not an explanation.
field_meanings.fields_that_differ: fields_that_differ lists which numeric fields moved between the two runs, by dotted path. Present so a reader does not have to trust the bit_identical count alone.

ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND.what: ablation.py::train_config calls torch.manual_seed(seed) AFTER constructing UnifiedTrunk and AdamW, not before. Weight initialisation therefore draws from whatever global RNG state exists at that moment. The seed controls only batch sampling; it never controls the initialisation.
ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND.why_the_control_matters: vector-realty reruns bit-identically on the same GPU with NO determinism controls at all (5 seeds, every value equal). It seeds before constructing the model. train_stage2.py, also reproducible here, does the same. That comparison is what located the bug.

hypotheses_falsified_on_the_way.nn.Embedding atomicAdd backward: UnifiedTrunk has two nn.Embedding layers and realty has none, so embedding backward looked like the difference. Running one epoch under use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False) raised NO error — torch considers every op it ran deterministic. Falsified.
hypotheses_falsified_on_the_way.warn_only=True hiding a refusal, and uns: Plausible, because the earlier attempted fix used warn_only=True with CUBLAS unset. Re-ran full@seed7 twice with warn_only=False AND CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8: 0.6834 vs 0.6962, every gate field differing. Falsified.

ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND.predicted_fix_NOT_APPLIED: Move torch.manual_seed(seed) and np.random.default_rng(seed) above the UnifiedTrunk construction. NOT done here: it changes what every historical ablation number means, and the three shipped ablation artifacts were produced by the current ordering. Whoever applies it should re-run the tables, not silently reinterpret them.
ROOT_CAUSE_FOUND.does_this_invalidate_the_ablation_CONCLU: No. The within-file comparisons were re-analysed unpaired earlier and held: full vs no_grl +0.0447 p<0.0001 SIG; no_coral +0.0008 p=0.9124 ns; no_vicreg -0.0115 p=0.1039 ns. What it explains is why full@seed7 has three different records across three artifacts.
